patterns.note: Content sections frequently use a two-column layout, pairing descriptive text on one side with detailed, full-fidelity UI screenshots of the Notion product on the other.
Complex product features and examples are presented within distinct card-like containers, often arranged in grids, showcasing various Notion UI states.

The site uses a high-contrast color scheme, with a deep, dark blue/purple for the hero section and clean white backgrounds for subsequent content sections, punctuated by bright, varied accent colors in illustrations and CTAs.
The hero section features a continuously looping video background with abstract, circuit-like illustrations and floating, playful icons.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.

technique_notes: A full-width video plays continuously in the hero section, serving as an animated background with a subtle dark overlay to maintain text contrast and readability.
The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, ensuring constant access to site navigation regardless of scroll depth.
Product features are visually demonstrated by embedding high-resolution, realistic UI screenshots directly into content blocks and cards, often accompanied by concise descriptive text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold headings (~3-4x body) establish strong hierarchy, complemented by clear, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and card-like UI elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a comfortable rhythm within content blocks, preventing visual clutter.

standout: The site's distinctive use of highly detailed, realistic UI screenshots as primary visual elements, integrated directly into the design rather than abstract illustrations, effectively showcases the product's depth and functionality. The animated, abstract 'night shift' hero background also sets a unique tone.
